description: Tasks template for modernization plan. Generate this file alongside plan.md to track individual migration tasks.

tasks.description: Scan project dependencies for known vulnerabilities and remediate identified CVEs.
tasks.reason: Security validation is required before Azure deployment to reduce known dependency risks.
tasks.requirements: Upgrade vulnerable dependencies to minimum patched versions. If a major-version upgrade is required, document impact and breaking-change risk. Validate project build and existing tests after remediation.
tasks.environmentConfiguration: Use the existing .NET Framework/MSBuild project environment already defined in the repository.

tasks.description: Deploy the application to Azure Container Apps, including required containerization flow.
tasks.reason: The modernization objective is Azure adoption with a cloud-hosted deployment target.
tasks.requirements: Package the application for container-based deployment and deploy to Azure Container Apps using existing or pre-created Azure resources. Use managed identity-based authentication where applicable.
